status_semantics.covered: Core source facts or event-window computation executable in catalog; documented warehouse event names apply
status_semantics.warehouse-adapted: Warehouse workload analogue with explicitly different queue/zone meanings; not byte-identical drone query
status_semantics.planner-owned: Catalog provides energy/task facts; route energy/reachability/completion calculation stays in existing planner, not claimed as computed by read API
status_semantics.not-applicable: Mutable current-vs-historical comparison excluded in favor of one coherent requested cutoff

reference_method: reviewed all i0-i55; no requirement to issue 56 network requests per decision

entries.name: current_drone_state
entries.description: 读取 drone 当前属性，作为 LLM 决策的基础自我状态。
entries.adaptation: robot identity/state at requested committed cutoff; latest mutable node excluded

entries.name: latest_agent_state
entries.description: 读取不晚于当前 step 的最新 AgentState，避免只依赖 Drone 快照。
entries.adaptation: exact committed snapshot, no latest-before ambiguity

entries.name: recent_self_trajectory
entries.description: 读取最近若干 step 的自身轨迹和状态变化，给 LLM 提供短期记忆。
entries.adaptation: complete bounded robot state window

entries.name: active_tasks_for_drone
entries.description: 读取当前 drone 已分配但未完成的任务，辅助 LLM 判断下一步行动。
entries.adaptation: one transport task per robot; warehouse queue_capacity differs from drone queue

entries.name: recent_drone_events
entries.description: 读取当前 drone 的近期事件，告诉 LLM 刚刚发生过什么。
entries.adaptation: robot-filtered event window

entries.name: recent_self_performance
entries.description: 把当前 drone 近期分配、取件、完成、超时次数压缩成 LLM 易用摘要。
entries.adaptation: window events and measured feedback; no missing sample inference

entries.name: current_region_load
entries.description: 读取当前 drone 所在区域在当前 step 的 agent 状态分布。
entries.adaptation: warehouse rack-zone load; no drone region/depot model

entries.name: nearby_drones_same_region
entries.description: 读取同一区域其他 drone 的状态并按队列/电量排序；距离候选请用 i32。
entries.adaptation: idle empty candidate facts, then planner energy/traffic gates

entries.name: known_open_tasks_in_region
entries.description: 读取当前区域内知识图谱已经知道的未完成且临近截止任务。
entries.adaptation: exact as-of task versions grouped by target rack zone

entries.name: latest_global_step_summary
entries.description: 读取不晚于当前 step 的全局 Step 摘要，给 LLM 提供系统态势。
entries.adaptation: committed Step plus fleet/bay counts

entries.name: region_recent_events
entries.description: 读取当前区域近期事件，帮助 LLM 了解局部拥堵、完成和异常情况。
entries.adaptation: global observed event kinds with explicit zone limitation

entries.name: global_region_bottlenecks
entries.description: 按区域聚合当前 step 的全局瓶颈，适合给 LLM 一个简短全局负载视角。
entries.adaptation: task pressure by rack zone and physical bay/fleet load

entries.name: self_capability_limits
entries.description: 读取自身队列/载货容量、速度和电量配置，给 LLM 提供行动约束。
entries.adaptation: warehouse energy configuration and payload policy remain planner authority

entries.name: self_snapshot_freshness
entries.description: 返回自身实际快照 step 和年龄，避免 LLM 把旧状态当成当前状态。
entries.adaptation: committed cutoff present and head lag; no inferred wall-time freshness

entries.name: self_recent_state_changes
entries.description: 对比近期窗口首末状态，压缩自身位置、队列、载货和电量变化。
entries.adaptation: endpoint coordinate/SOC/distance changes

entries.name: self_recent_status_samples
entries.description: 按状态汇总自身历史样本，帮助 LLM 判断持续空闲或持续忙碌；不是连续时长。
entries.adaptation: stage sample counts, explicitly not continuous durations

entries.name: self_stationary_evidence
entries.description: 返回自身窗口内坐标包围范围和任务负载，辅助判断是否需要排查停滞。
entries.adaptation: raw complete state window permits stationary review, no automatic fault inference

entries.name: self_operational_status
entries.description: 读取自身现有运行状态和负载，识别返航/充电；不推断未记录的故障或互助模式。
entries.adaptation: actual stage and carrying status

entries.name: self_active_task_summary
entries.description: 把自身当前有效任务汇总为待取件、载货和最早截止信息。
entries.adaptation: single active transport task, no drone multi-task queue

entries.name: self_pending_pickup_locations
entries.description: 查询自身待取任务在现有 Task 上记录的取件点。
entries.adaptation: source/target location in exact task version

entries.name: self_onboard_delivery_targets
entries.description: 读取自身实际携带的未完成任务和投递目标，避免把历史 CARRYING 当作当前载货。
entries.adaptation: carrying task/target and goods custody

entries.name: self_urgent_task_slack
entries.description: 查询自身即将到期及已逾期任务的剩余时间，辅助 LLM 确定优先级。
entries.adaptation: overdue task counts by zone; exact task due available via task

entries.name: self_overdue_active_tasks
entries.description: 定位自身当前仍需处理的逾期任务，用于补救和求助判断。
entries.adaptation: as-of incomplete overdue task counts

entries.name: self_task_action_candidates
entries.description: 给出自身任务对应的取件/投递候选动作及直线距离，不假定图谱记录了完整队列顺序。
entries.adaptation: task source/target, action selection remains warehouse planner

entries.name: self_direct_completion_estimates
entries.description: 估算自身每个任务的直达完成时间下界；不包含队列绕行和等待，供 LLM 识别明显风险。
entries.adaptation: route completion feasibility remains SIPP/energy planner, no Euclidean ETA presented as route

entries.name: self_active_task_event_context
entries.description: 读取自身当前任务的近期分配、取件和完成事件及真实执行者。
entries.adaptation: task-filtered committed event window

entries.name: self_recent_assignments
entries.description: 读取自身近期真实派单事件及当时队列长度。
entries.adaptation: assignment events visible in selected robot window

entries.name: self_recent_pickups
entries.description: 读取自身近期真实取件事件及当时载货数量。
entries.adaptation: picked events and actual actor

entries.name: self_pending_pickup_ages
entries.description: 为自身当前待取任务查找此前最近派单时间，识别等待取件较久的任务。
entries.adaptation: assignment-to-pickup observations, window missing starts explicit

entries.name: self_onboard_delivery_ages
entries.description: 读取自身当前载货任务的已观察配送时间和剩余截止时间。
entries.adaptation: picked_at/due fields in exact task payload; source observation time explicit

entries.name: self_recent_completed_tasks
entries.description: 以真实完成事件列出自身近期送达任务与 deadline，不以 Task 最新完成状态替代历史。
entries.adaptation: placed/shipped events and task feedback

entries.name: self_recent_event_type_summary
entries.description: 按实际事件类型汇总自身近期活动，不假定存在协助事件。
entries.adaptation: actual event-kind counts

entries.name: self_nearby_available_peers
entries.description: 按距离、已知队列容量和电量筛选附近无人机；仅是候选信息，不声称已派遣协助。
entries.adaptation: Euclidean radius lower bound plus observed idle/empty/minSOC filters

entries.name: self_task_peer_route_estimates
entries.description: 用已有任务和无人机位置/电量估算其他无人机的单任务直达路线；不是实际协助关系或完整队列可行性。
entries.adaptation: candidate facts only; shared planner validates actual route/energy

entries.name: self_cross_region_peer_candidates
entries.description: 按同一步位置、队列和电量返回半径内其他区域的无人机候选信息。
entries.adaptation: warehouse peer search spans rack zones within requested radius

entries.name: self_nearby_returning_peers
entries.description: 读取同一步附近正在返航/充电的无人机，避免把它们当成可立即接单资源。
entries.adaptation: all robot stages and 100 physical bay occupancy facts

entries.name: self_region_queue_comparison
entries.description: 比较自身与同一步同区域其他无人机的队列负载，不假定存在协助承诺。
entries.adaptation: warehouse single-task/stage load in place of drone queue comparisons

entries.name: self_recent_served_regions
entries.description: 按真实完成事件汇总自身近期服务过的任务区域，而不是把区域边当实时位置。
entries.adaptation: actual task completion events; supplied task IDs retain slot-zone references

entries.name: self_known_depot_return_margin
entries.description: 结合已知 depot、当前位置和安全余量估算返航阈值；depot 不完整时仅是已知范围内结果。
entries.adaptation: SOC/reserves/bay facts; complete return energy admission stays in planner

entries.name: self_reachable_known_depots
entries.description: 列出按自身电量和安全余量可到达的已知 depot，支持返航目的地选择。
entries.adaptation: canonical bay occupancy and reservations; reachability stays planner controlled

entries.name: self_individual_task_energy_estimates
entries.description: 估算单项任务直达取送及最近已知 depot 的最低航程需求，不包含其他任务队列绕行。
entries.adaptation: loaded route energy evaluation belongs to current warehouse planner

entries.name: self_recent_charge_cycle_events
entries.description: 读取自己的低电量、返航和充电完成事件，解释电量变化原因。
entries.adaptation: battery measurement, charge reservation/start/completion events

entries.name: self_observed_battery_changes
entries.description: 聚合自身相邻快照的电量升降，提供观察到的放电和恢复证据，不推断缺失步。
entries.adaptation: full sampled SOC changes; no depletion inferred between missing steps

entries.name: self_last_known_charge
entries.description: 读取截至决策时间的最近充电完成记录，判断距上次充电多久；无记录表示未知。
entries.adaptation: charge_complete in requested window; absent means unknown

entries.name: self_region_known_task_pressure
entries.description: 统计自己当前区域内图谱已知的未完成、逾期与待取件任务，不声称覆盖尚未入图任务。
entries.adaptation: cutoff task versions/overdue counts by slot rack zone

entries.name: self_region_available_queue_capacity
entries.description: 汇总自身区域其他无人机的已知可用队列容量，提供区域资源信息。
entries.adaptation: fleet stage load rather than unsupported drone queue capacity

entries.name: self_region_recent_completion_quality
entries.description: 汇总自身当前区域近期完成与迟到情况，给 LLM 一个局部服务质量视角。
entries.adaptation: observed completion feedback; no future deadline outcome label

entries.name: self_region_recent_task_flow
entries.description: 统计自己区域近期真实派单、取件和送达事件及参与无人机数量。
entries.adaptation: global window event counts; event-zone inference intentionally excluded

entries.name: self_nearby_known_open_tasks
entries.description: 读取自身附近图谱已知的未完成紧急任务及承担者，不假定等待任务已入图或可以重复派单。
entries.adaptation: target rack-zone task pressure; assignment ownership in exact task query

entries.name: self_nearby_low_battery_peers
entries.description: 按同一步电量和已知低电基准阈值识别附近低电无人机，不替代动态返航判据。
entries.adaptation: all fleet SOC/stages available; live emergency decision remains planner

entries.name: self_assignment_to_pickup_feedback
entries.description: 为近期派单匹配下次同任务派单前的首次取件，观察实际等待时间；未取件不等于失败。
entries.adaptation: observed assignment-to-pickup attempts

entries.name: self_release_to_completion_feedback
entries.description: 根据真实完成事件与 Task 释放/deadline 时间回顾端到端耗时和逾期分钟。
entries.adaptation: release-to-completion only when start and finish visible

entries.name: self_current_snapshot_comparison
entries.description: 并列返回自身当前属性与目标 step 快照的差异，提示 LLM 时间混用，不直接判为数据错误。
entries.adaptation: one coherent historical cutoff; separate mutable-current comparisons excluded

entries.name: self_recent_snapshot_coverage
entries.description: 检查自己的短期记忆窗口中有多少不同 step 样本，避免把缺样本当成没有行动。
entries.adaptation: contiguous state commits required through cutoff

entries.name: self_recent_delivery_feedback
entries.description: 把自己的完成事件与此前最近取件事件关联，回顾实际投递耗时及迟到情况。
entries.adaptation: picked-to-placed/shipped feedback when observed

entries.name: self_decision_data_readiness
entries.description: 检查自身实体、快照新鲜度及容量/速度配置是否齐备，返回可解释的决策数据缺口。
entries.adaptation: snapshot/hash/cutoff checks plus explicit live-action recheck requirement
